reviewSamples.author: Nona Schor
reviewSamples.text: I have two very special Ragdoll cats that need to be trimmed at least twice a year, I don't trust just anyone, they did such an amazing job, they come to you (important as I don't want my cats sitting with barking dogs and getting stressed out) and it's a one on one!! They did a spectacular job!!!!!

reviewSamples.author: Laura Sanchez
reviewSamples.text: Oswaldo groomed both of my Goldendoodles and did a wonderful job! I always ask for a short summer cut, and most groomers don't quite get it right, but Oswaldo replicated the example I showed him perfectly. Both of my boys look amazing!

reviewSamples.author: Heather Nottingham
reviewSamples.text: This was our first time using this company for a mobile grooming for our dog. She had an accident the other day and so we washed her outside but we didn't do a great job so she still smelled bad. We needed her to be professionally cleaned (truncated on Google).

reviewSamples.author: Paula Dayana
reviewSamples.text: I couldn't be happier with the grooming service for my dog, Gipa! The groomer (Lina) was incredibly professional, patient, and so sweet with her from start to finish.

reviewSamples.author: Taylour Musto
reviewSamples.text: Great job Jose! My four doggies looked the best they've ever looked!
